One-for-one swaps of players at different positions, judged by how much each team's best starting lineup (QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, TE, FLEX) scores per week for the rest of the season. Numbers = points per week each lineup gains (or gives up). Every team gets at least one idea: win-wins first (both gain), then smaller win-wins with ranks a little further apart, then even swaps where one team gains and the other gives up less than a point a week. Each player and each pair of teams appears once.
